title: Joyal localization is Cat-infinity
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, categorical equivalences and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], homotopy coherent localizations in the sense of [def-coef-coherent-localization-interface], simplicial categories, locally Kan replacement and the homotopy coherent nerve of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and the infinity category $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$ of small quasicategories of [lem-coef-cat-infinity-colimits-cartesian-closure]. Let $W_{\mathrm J}$ be the class of categorical equivalences between small simplicial sets, and let $q:N(\mathsf{sSet})\to\mathcal L$ be a homotopy coherent localization of the ordinary category of small simplicial sets at $W_{\mathrm J}$ (for instance the homotopy coherent nerve of a locally Kan replacement of its hammock localization). Then there is an equivalence of infinity categories $\Phi:\mathcal L\simeq\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$ together with equivalences $\Phi(q(Q))\simeq Q$ for every small quasicategory $Q$, natural in simplicial maps between quasicategories, so that $\Phi q$ restricted to quasicategories is the inclusion of small quasicategories into $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$. The equivalence is induced by the Joyal--Bergner coherent-nerve Quillen equivalence and the derived coherent nerve, and concerns the ordinary Joyal model with its cartesian mapping objects, with no Kan-enrichment hypothesis. It holds in every universe and is compatible with enlarging the universe.
